title: Timber HUD
description: Timber HUD adds an size-modifiable, wooden-styled HUD showing in-game time, player age, current biome, weather, facing direction, and coordinates.
body:
![Timber HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e4f4c50618bb92ec9fb9854bdd570cb4e08413f_0.webp)🌲 Timber HUD

Timber HUD is a lightweight, immersive, wooden-style HUD mod that provides essential world and player information directly on your screen—without clutter or distraction.

Designed to feel natural in survival gameplay, Timber HUD dynamically resizes to its content, stays visually stable while you play, and can be adjusted to your preferred size at any time.

📊 What Timber HUD Displays

In-game time (12-hour AM/PM format)

Player age in in-game hours, matching the world’s time flow

Age pauses while the player is dead

Current biome

Weather status

Facing direction (cardinal + diagonal)

Player coordinates (X, Y, Z)

🪵 Design & Behavior

Wooden, survival-friendly UI style

Automatically resizes to fit text

Prevents distracting size changes while looking around

Shrinks smoothly after a short cooldown instead of instantly

Text is padded to keep the HUD visually stable

🔧 Customization

Use simple client-side commands to adjust the HUD size:

/timberhud small

/timberhud medium

/timberhud large

Changes apply instantly—no restart required.

⚡ Performance Friendly

Client-side only

Throttled updates to avoid unnecessary calculations

No gameplay impact and safe to use on servers

🧩 Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.1

NeoForge

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Timber HUD aims to give you the information you need, when you need it, in a way that feels like it belongs in the world.
